text:
```yaml
name: Deploy Lexical Search Worker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: services/lexical-search-worker
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        working-directory: services/lexical-search-worker
        run: |
          npm run test
          npm run typecheck
          npm run lint

      - name: Build project
        working-directory: services/lexical-search-worker
        run: npm run build

  deploy-to-cloudflare:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: services/lexical-search-worker
        run: npm install

      - name: Authenticate with Cloudflare
        run: echo "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" | cfctl auth login --api-token -

      - name: Deploy Worker
        run: |
          cd services/lexical-search-worker
          wrangler publish --env production
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up two jobs: one for building and testing the `lexical-search-worker` service, and another for deploying it to Cloudflare Workers when changes are pushed to the `main` branch or a pull request is opened against it. The deployment job requires authentication with Cloudflare using a token stored as a secret in the repository settings.
